ios.desc:
The most complete ski map ever built.

PistePal pairs high-resolution trail maps with live navigation, tracking, and location sharing — across thousands of resorts worldwide.

	•	High-resolution trail maps for 6,000+ ski resorts worldwide – never wonder where you are on the mountain.
	•	Turn-by-turn navigation – get directions to runs, lifts, and other places. Filter routes by ability level, preview the route in first-person, and check your next turn on the lock screen - without taking off your gloves!
	•	2D and 3D map views, with trails color-coded by difficulty exactly like real-world signage.
	•	Topographic and satellite maps, plus layer filters for difficulty, runs, and lifts.
	•	Offline maps – once downloaded, your ski maps stay with you – even without cell service.
	•	Live location sharing with friends and family – keep your crew connected on every run.
	•	Lost sight of your crew? Instantly see whether your friends are above or below you on the run, right from the lock screen.
	•	Meetups – pick a rendezvous and let PistePal guide everyone there, no texting or guessing required.
	•	Favorites – pin great lines, secret powder stashes, and après spots. Share with friends and find your way back every time.
	•	Replay your Tracks – never lose track of a great line or hidden spot again. Your full day is captured automatically, works without signal, and syncs seamlessly across devices.
	•	Run Stats – break down your day. Distance, runs, vertical drop, time on snow, and max speed are tracked seamlessly as you ride.
	•	Fast, powerful search for runs, lifts, resorts, and places – jump straight to what you need in seconds.
	•	Nearby amenities at a glance – see lifts, lodges, restaurants, rentals, washrooms, and more right on the map.
	•	Backcountry coverage for another 7,000 mapped areas – explore far beyond the resort boundary.
	•	Trip Planning - list all resorts, and sort by difficulty level, most trails, total trail length, most lifts, most vertical, highest summit, and largest area.

The full feature set is available with a simple $10/year subscription. A free tier provides basic map and search, and a 1-hour daily free trial lets you experience location and navigation features before you subscribe.

PistePal – your mountain, mapped like never before.

quotes.text:
https://pistepal.app/ - a ski map app - built at breakneck speed over the last few months. I believe this is the only ski map app that offers turn-by-turn navigation!

Screenshots in the App Stores, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pistepal/id6754510927

Still a little bit rough around the edges but hopefully will be / is in decent enough shape for the start of the ski season (just about happening now..)

Currently figuring out the right balance of free tier & daily trial. Priced at $10/month and therefore significantly undercutting the competition, hopefully this is enough to gain entry into the market. (May need a more generous daily trial though, admittedly 10 minutes is not really enough to actually try it out on the mountain).

Seems ad spend is necessary to get any kind of traction...

Feedback welcome!
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What Are You Working On? (December 2025)
